# Daydream Gallery

> A personal gallery of animated scenes and interactive art.

All scenes were developed with AI. The runtime is browser code, not an AI generation service.

## Experience

Choose from 9 scenes at [Daydream Gallery](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/).

Use the upper-right envelope, immediately left of the information icon, to send an opinion without a name or email address. Close the dialog with Close or Esc. A failed submission preserves your draft.

Choose an image on the home screen to open a scene. Use the home icon to return or the image-list icon to select another scene. The bottom controls offer a new scene, global play/pause, a music panel and a view without controls. The information icon opens a centered dialog without imagery. Its glass surface and text adapt to the scene, and the backdrop dims while open. Click plain content or the backdrop, use Close, or press Esc to dismiss; language buttons and links remain interactive. The New Scene button stays visible but disabled in Arctic Aurora and White Sands.

Scene entry attempts music playback immediately. If autoplay is blocked, the music note shows a slash; click/tap the scene or press M to start. The slash also indicates pause or zero volume. Explicit music pause is preserved across scene changes. Open the music-note panel to control playback. Skip tracks, edit order, shuffle, repeat one song and adjust volume. All tracks play 12 dB quieter than before. Wisps of Whorls uses click removal and noise reduction. Playback shuffles six tracks once on entry; that order stays until explicitly edited. Scenes preserve track, volume and order. Music/global pause, home and hidden tabs suspend playback at its current position. The public export uses Journey, three retained CC0 recordings, Wisps of Whorls and Deep Relaxation. Deep Relaxation appears as one song and plays three chronological parts.

Space toggles global playback, R creates a new scene where supported, M toggles music playback, and F hides the controls. Esc closes an open panel first, otherwise hides controls. Number keys select scenes in menu order. Controls hide after three idle seconds. Click, tap, Tab or a supported shortcut reveals them; pointer movement alone does not.

ASCII Bloom randomizes the shape and color on entry and after every click/tap. You can also choose the next brush in the bottom bar. In the scene picker, use arrow keys to move, Enter to select and Esc to close. Each artwork has its own address and sharing preview. Older hash links still open; scene links support reload and browser Back.

## Available scenes

- [Tenebrae](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/tenebrae/): Wreaths of oversized flowers, painted like oil, turn slowly in the dark. Blooms open as they enter the light and close as they leave it, while a great central flower stays fully grown, slowly drifts and rotates about its own axis. Attached petals and leaves flex gently; drifting petals flow around flowers and stems. Each visit and each new scene takes one of five colour schemes at random: old-master warmth, neon magenta, orange and blue, acid or ice.
- [Arctic Aurora](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/arctic-aurora/): Aurora flows above a small iceberg and reflects across a dark sea in one continuous scene.
- [ASCII Bloom](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/ascii-bloom/): Click or tap to send a wave through a field of characters. Shape and color are randomized on entry and after every stamp.
- [Paper Wings](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/paper-wings/): Seventeen butterfly families fly independently over hanji paper.
- [White Sands](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/white-sands/): A small tree and one red apple above white dunes. Wind stirs the leaves and lifts sand from the crests while a three-minute cycle turns the day to sunset, a starlit night and dawn.
- [Glass Valley](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/glass-valley/): Travel through a stained-glass mountain valley. Drag to look around.
- [Quiet Ascent](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/quiet-ascent/): A small rocket rises through stars, drifting gas and occasional planets.
- [Stillwater](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/stillwater/): Water, plants, fish, clouds and falling leaves move through a quiet pond.
- [Journey](https://daydream.mmonoo.com/scenes/journey/): An isometric drive through coastal, desert and forest landscapes.

## Source

- [Public source code](https://github.com/simpleusername96/daydream-gallery): Generated reviewed runtime, documentation, notices and licenses.
